reference.scope: ds005385 session-1 pre-task resting condition-specific experimental cohort reference

dataset_overlay.dataset_version: OpenNeuro ds005385 v1.0.3; NEMAR on005385 v1.0.0; DOI 10.82901/nemar.on005385
dataset_overlay.resampling_method: MNE resample to 250 Hz using common EEG preprocessing
dataset_overlay.filter_specification: 50 Hz notch; 1-45 Hz EEG bandpass; candidate alpha estimator applies a separate 8-12 Hz order-4 zero-phase Butterworth filter
dataset_overlay.channel_selection: all 64 EEG channels present in each source file, native ordered labels; no channel dropping or interpolation
dataset_overlay.bad_channel_policy: variance/correlation channel-drop heuristic disabled; no channel interpolation or silent drop
dataset_overlay.continuous_segment_boundaries: source-file boundary plus any nonfinite all-channel sample runs; never bridge source files or concatenated epoched input
dataset_overlay.edge_support_policy: alpha envelope/Hilbert values require a full window and a 10 s symmetric source-segment edge guard; support reason is emitted per window
dataset_overlay.estimator_parameter_manifest: estimators section plus runtime SHA256 of the executed preprocessing, feature, candidate, and coordinate assembly code

reference.session_policy: caller_selected_rows; cohort protocol should select first-session pre-task recordings
reference.artifact_qc_status: not_established_by_anchor_fit; preserve the per-window qc_ok_eeg value and interpret -1 as not assessed
reference.eligibility_rule: finite measurement-specific estimator inputs and declared channel/reference surface; technical row filtering is recorded by the caller
